title: אדמון בן גדאי

paragraphs: Admon ben Gaddai and Chanan ben Avishalom, two judges of decrees, Ketubbot, chapter 13, mishnayot 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9; Bava Batra, chapter 9, 1; Shevuot, chapter 6, 13. Rabban Gamliel said, “I see Admon’s words.” In that mishnah: Rabbi Dosa ben Harkinas (see Chanan ben Avishalom); Rabban Gamliel said, “I see Admon’s words,” Shevuot 38b, Mishnah. Avtalyon was in his time. Yuchasin, in the chronological order, writes that Maimonides’ placing Rabbi Meyasha in their company does not seem correct (see there).
